title.zh: [galactic_market_station_system.GetName]泛星系贸易市场总部被拆除

texts.zh: 根据[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]宪章第19条C款，只有一个会员国可以主办泛星系贸易市场。因此，市场在[galactic_market_station_system.GetName]星系的总部已经被拆除。最后一位交易员在今天不情愿地放弃了他们的岗位，哀叹这一戏剧性的——在他们看来——不必要的步骤对星系贸易造成了巨大的破坏。[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]的贸易董事会已提出陈词对该事态表示遗憾。他们允诺，在[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]内新主办国的选举将会很快开始。
texts.en: According to article 19C of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s charter, only a member state may host the Galactic Market. As such, the market's headquarters in the [galactic_market_station_system.GetName] system has been dismantled. The last traders reluctantly abandoned their posts today, bemoaning the massive disruption to galactic trade that this dramatic and - in their view - needless step has caused. The [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]'s Board of Commerce has issued a statement expressing regret for this state of affairs. They promise that nominations for a new host within the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium] will commence immediately.

label.en: It is a price worth paying.

notes.zh: 入口一：成员离开社群（on_remove_community_member → 62）而其星球是市场总部；入口二：迁移决议通过（galcom.64）。
notes.en: Entry one: a member leaves the community (on_remove_community_member -> 62) and its planet is the market headquarters; entry two: the relocation resolution passes (galcom.64).

title.zh: 挑选泛星系贸易市场新总部
title.en: New Headquarters for Galactic Market Sought

texts.zh: 随着[From.GetName]选择离开[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]，我们不得不执行[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]宪章中的一项晦涩难懂的条款，其大意是只有成员国才能主导泛星系贸易市场。因此，市场在[galactic_market_station_system.GetName]星系的总部已经被拆除。最后一位交易员在今天不情愿地放弃了他们的岗位，哀叹这一戏剧性的——在他们看来——不必要的步骤对星系贸易造成了巨大的破坏。对新总部的选址提名已经开始，[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]的商务董事会发布生命对当前形势表示遗憾。他们保障将尽快找到新的主办国。
texts.en: With the [From.GetName] opting to leave the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium], an obscure article of the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]'s charter must be applied, to the effect that only a member state may host the Galactic Market. As such, the market's headquarters in the [galactic_market_station_system.GetName] system has been dismantled. The last traders reluctantly abandoned their posts today, bemoaning the massive disruption to galactic trade that this dramatic and - in their view - needless step has caused. Nominations for the headquarters' new location have already opened, with the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]'s Board of Commerce expressing regret for this state of affairs. They promise that a new host will be found swiftly.

label.zh: 也许这对我们而言是一次机会……
label.en: Perhaps this represents an opportunity for us...

label.zh: 那我们只能嘲笑他们的愚蠢了。
label.en: We can only laugh at their foolishness.

title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场的成立

texts.zh: 国际贸易论坛即将成立，而其中央贸易空间站的控制者必将从中获益。[GetMarketFoundingChainEnd]
texts.en: The establishment of an international commercial forum is nigh, and whoever controls the centralized exchange station stands to benefit.[GetMarketFoundingChainEnd]

title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场：未成立

texts.zh:
很不幸，我们发起的建立泛星系贸易市场的动议碰壁了。虽然我们明显成功地为该计划调动了政治意愿，但却没收到任何有效的主办地提名。

原则上，商业说客和政治拥趸都支持这个想法，并发誓会加倍努力，只要[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]希望再次尝试。
texts.en:
Our motion to bring forth a new Galactic Market has unfortunately failed. While we clearly succeeded in mustering the political will for such a scheme, it did not receive any valid nominations for a host site.

Commercial lobbyists and political proponents alike stand by the idea in principle, having vowed to redouble their efforts should the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] wish to try again.

title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场：未成立

texts.zh:
看来星系的市场范围无法承载其政治意图。苦于缺乏有效的主办地提名，最近 [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]为构建专门的交易中心而做出的努力都白费了。

泛星系贸易市场计划的支持者们旋即表明一点都不觉得尴尬，声称只要[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]认为时机成熟，他们将再次提出自己的主张。
texts.en:
It would seem the galaxy's political will has exceeded the reach of its markets. Recent efforts by the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] to establish a dedicated trading hub have failed, with no valid nominations for a host site.

Proponents of the Galactic Market scheme were quick to deny any hint of embarrassment, declaring that they will make their case again whenever the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium] considers itself ready.

texts.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的市场范围无法承载其政治意图，因为最近他们为形成统一的泛星系贸易市场而做出的努力都白费了。到头来，异种人备受推崇的项目连一个有效的主办地提名都没能吸引到。

计划的支持者否认这表明异星人的“合作”想法是弄巧成拙。相反，他们坚定地宣称，如果星系的成员认为时机成熟了，可以再次尝试。
texts.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s political will has exceeded the reach of its markets, as their recent effort to form a unified Galactic Market has failed. After all was said and done, the xenos' much-vaunted project couldn't entice a single valid nomination for a host site.

Proponents of the scheme have denied that this exposes the true folly behind ideas about xeno 'collaboration'. Instead they are resolute in claims that the galaxy may try again, when its members consider themselves ready.

texts.zh: 我们对[market_founder_planet.GetName]进行的推广宣传有了收获，而贸易巨头们决定将大部分商业活动集中在[market_founder_planet.GetStarName]星系内！
texts.en: Our marketing campaign on [market_founder_planet.GetName] has borne fruit, and the market-powers-that-be have seen fit to centralize much of their activity within the [market_founder_planet.GetStarName] system!

tooltips.zh: 泛星系贸易市场空间站已成立于[galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName]星系
tooltips.en: Galactic Market Station established in the [galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName] system

title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场：已成立

texts.zh: 泛星系贸易中心已被设立在[galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName]恒星系，位于[From.GetName]境内。[From.GetAdj]政府已经正式宣布这一市场合法，资源已经可以通过中立第三方进行买卖。
texts.en: The center of galactic commerce has manifested in the [galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName] system, within the borders of the [From.GetName]. The [From.GetAdj] administration has officially legitimized this marketplace, where resources can be bought and sold through unaffiliated third parties.

texts.zh: 心怀鬼胎的[From.GetName]异种建立了一个外星商品的交易市场。尽管我们对此不屑一顾，但市场的大门仍对我们敞开。
texts.en: The dubious xenos of the [From.GetName] have established a marketplace for the trade of alien goods. While we are naturally loath to take part in this exchange, the option is available to us.

title.zh: 挑选泛星系贸易市场新总部
title.en: New Headquarters for Galactic Market Sought

texts.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经表态，迁移泛星系贸易市场的新一轮竞争由此展开。位于[market_founder_planet.solar_system.GetName]星系的的市场总部已经开始收尾工作，交易员的关注都集中在未来几年的预测上。他们哀叹这一戏剧性的——且在他们看来并不必要的决定对泛星系贸易造成了巨大的破坏。

总部新址的提名已经开始，[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]的商业委员会发表了一份声明，对这种状况表示遗憾。他们承诺将尽快找到一个新的星系。
texts.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has spoken, and a new competition has begun to relocate the Galactic Market. The market's headquarters in the [market_founder_planet.solar_system.GetName] system has begun wind-down operations, with traders focusing solely on forecasts for the next few years. They bemoan the massive disruption to galactic trade that this dramatic and - in their view - needless step has already caused.

Nominations for the headquarters' new location have already opened, with the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]'s Board of Commerce issuing a statement expressing regret at this state of affairs. They promise that a new host will be found swiftly.

label.zh: 这将使我们的成员切实收益。
label.en: This may indeed benefit our members.

texts.zh: 我们对[market_founder_planet.GetName]进行的推广宣传有了收获，而贸易巨头们决定将大部分商业活动集中在[market_founder_planet.GetStarName]星系内！
texts.en: Our marketing campaign on [market_founder_planet.GetName] has borne fruit, and the market-powers-that-be have seen fit to centralize much of their activity within the [market_founder_planet.GetStarName] system!

tooltips.zh: 泛星系贸易市场空间站已成立于[galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName]星系
tooltips.en: Galactic Market Station established in the [galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName] system

title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场留在原址

texts.zh:
我们迁移泛星系贸易市场的动议不幸失败。尽管我们的努力争取到了大量口头支持，却没有转化为新地点的足够提名。

这一意见原则上仍然合理：[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]今后还是可以再次提出迁移市场。然而就目前而言，这个商业机构仍然由获利丰厚的[market_founder.GetName]进行管理。
texts.en:
Our motion to relocate the Galactic Market has unfortunately failed. While we mustered significant vocal support for the endeavor, this did not translate into enough valid nominations for a new host site.

The idea remains sound in principle: the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] may propose moving the Market again in future, if it so desires. For now though, this commercial institution remains in the lucrative care of the [market_founder.GetName].

title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场留在原址

texts.zh: 泛星系商业最近经历了一次短暂而混乱的复苏，有消息称迁移泛星系市场的努力已经失败。尽管[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]声明希望迁移这一机构，但他们没有收到任何替代东道主的可靠提名。因此，[market_founder.GetName]将继续担任其东道主，直到政治变革的风向再次转向，通过投票寻找到替代。
texts.en: Galactic commerce experienced a brief and confusing resurgence recently, with news that the effort to relocate the Galactic Market has failed. Despite the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s stated desire to move this institution, they received no valid nominations for a replacement host. As a result, the [market_founder.GetName] shall remain its hosts until the winds of political change swing back to polling for a replacement.

texts.zh:
泛星系的政治意愿显然与其市场的意愿不一致。在引起了广泛的金融混乱之后，[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]想要取消我们作为其专属交易中心东道主的努力已经失败，因为没有其他帝国给出有效的东道主提名。

这项动议的支持者们不为所动，断言泛星系市场随时可能根据商业需要进行迁移到别处。不过就目前而言，在经历了这么多忙乱之后，泛星系最重要的商人们还是更愿意相信我们。
texts.en:
The galaxy's political will is clearly not aligned with that of its markets. After having caused widespread financial upset, the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s effort to remove us as hosts to its dedicated trading hub has failed, with no other empires putting forward a valid nomination for a host site.

Proponents of this motion are unfazed, affirming that the Galactic Market may yet move wherever and whenever commercial needs dictate. For now though, it would seem that after all that fuss, the galaxy's foremost merchants prefer to keep their trust in us.

texts.en: The establishment of an international commercial forum is nigh, and whoever controls the centralized exchange station stands to benefit.[GetMarketFoundingChainEnd]

# [galactic_market_station_system.GetName]泛星系贸易市场总部被拆除 / [galactic_market_station_system.GetName] Stripped of Galactic Market Headquarters

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/galactic_community_events.txt:701-775,1213-1500`；`events/on_action_events_2.txt:131-420`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:4419`；`common/resolutions/00_resolutions.txt:13706`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 入口一：成员退出银河社群（on_remove_community_member，00_on_actions.txt:4420）而其拥有银河市场总部星球 → galcom.62「被剥夺银河市场总部」。入口二：决议“迁移银河市场”通过 → galcom.64「寻找新总部」。
  Entry one: a member leaves the Galactic Community (on_remove_community_member, 00_on_actions.txt:4420) and owned the market headquarters planet -> galcom.62 "Stripped of Galactic Market Headquarters". Entry two: the relocation resolution passes -> galcom.64 "New Headquarters for Galactic Market Sought".

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 62 → 其他成员收到 63「寻找新总部」并开启 market_founding_chain；1800天后 action.98 提名：有候选 → action.104「银河市场在……建立」→ action.101；无候选 → action.1000 / 1005「市场未建立」。
  62 -> other members get 63 "New Headquarters Sought" and start the market_founding_chain; after 1800 days action.98 nominates: with a candidate -> action.104 "Galactic Market: Established in …" -> action.101; without -> action.1000 / 1005 "Market Not Established".
- 64 → 立即 65 与 market_relocation_chain；提名期后 galcom.66（隐藏）：有提名星球 → 68「银河市场在……建立」→ action.101；否则 69 / 70「银河市场留在原地」。
  64 -> at once 65 and the market_relocation_chain; after the nomination period hidden galcom.66: a nominee planet -> 68 "Galactic Market: Established in …" -> action.101; otherwise 69 / 70 "Galactic Market Remains in Place".

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 两条入口并行；各自结果互斥。
  The two entries are parallel; each line's results are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无。
  None.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：入口 on_action、提名期延迟、候选判定与结果事件。
  Checked: entry on_actions, the nomination delays, candidate tests and result events.
- 更正：galcom.64 原为单独故事，与 62 共用 action.101，现并入。
  Correction: galcom.64 was a separate story sharing action.101 with 62; merged.
